title: Final Production Release Audit

python_device_ai.note: 1 pre-existing unrelated benchmark-timing flake, carried since P6.2, observed both passing and failing across this session's runs

backend_jest.note: one initial run showed 1 failure due to a port collision with this session's own live docker-compose stack (P7.5/P7.8) occupying :8100 — not a code defect; stack stopped, suite re-run clean, stack restarted

database.migration_chain: linear, 3 alembic revisions + 6 Prisma migrations, unchanged structure

real_defect_found.description: version_table_col_length=64 in alembic/env.py is not a real Alembic parameter (verified absent from EnvironmentContext.configure()'s signature and alembic.runtime.migration's source); Alembic's real hardcoded default is VARCHAR(32), too narrow for this project's revision IDs (up to 36 chars); a fresh `alembic upgrade head` failed with StringDataRightTruncation on migration 003
real_defect_found.how_the_existing_db_worked: the shared ecotrace database's alembic_version table was manually widened to VARCHAR(64) via direct SQL outside any tracked migration, at an undocumented point in the past — never reproducible
real_defect_found.fix: env.py now pre-creates alembic_version with a real VARCHAR(64) column via idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS before Alembic's bootstrap runs; a related bug in the first draft (table silently rolling back, uncommitted) was caught and fixed with an explicit connection.commit()
real_defect_found.verification: full upgrade -> downgrade base -> re-upgrade head round-trip performed against a disposable database (ecotrace_migration_test, created and dropped), never against the shared real database; real 35-device dataset confirmed untouched throughout

blockchain.fabric_gateway_client: real gRPC client against vendored authentic protos; P7.9 added a genuine RPC timeout test (slow-but-reachable peer) proving fabric_timeout_seconds is actually enforced
blockchain.external_trust: real in-memory ExternalTrustLedger, same API contract as a live backend, re-proven in P7.8's live demo
blockchain.unavailable_behavior: FabricUnavailable raised correctly for both connection failure and RPC timeout; backend proxy degrades to proxy_unreachable with HTTP 200, never 5xx
blockchain.live_fabric_status: no Hyperledger Fabric peer/orderer/CA exists anywhere in this repository or environment — re-confirmed this phase, not assumed

security.tls: Fabric client has no insecure fallback; application-layer TLS termination honestly documented as a real gap in 11_DEPLOYMENT.md, not claimed as solved
security.auth_rbac: JWT+bcrypt backend, server-side authorize middleware authoritative, frontend RoleGuard explicitly UX-only
security.rate_limiting: authRateLimiter + apiRateLimiter (P7.4) + /predict limiter (Python, P7.4); concurrency-safety proven under real thread contention (P7.9)
